title: QF Issue #9 hypothesis card
source: GitHub Issue #9 'Required hypothesis schema' (verbatim field list), plus the study's screening declarations block.

hypothesis_id.description: Unique within the run; assigned by the producing arm.

family_id.description: Strategy-family identifier used for registry dedupe (family-string match).

origin_arm.description: Stripped before blind grading; restored from the blinding key after scoring.

bar_definition.description: Must carry timeframe, timezone and decision_time, e.g. '4H bars, America/New_York, 09:30 anchor; decision at bar close; fill next bar open'.

pit_route.description: Empty string if none; otherwise the precisely specified feasible point-in-time route.

overlap_with_previous_family.description: 'none' or the registry entry overlapped, with justification.

provenance.description: Must contain IDEA_ONLY; model-generated content is tagged SIMULATED per Issue #9.

critique_summary.description: Optional during generation; required on final cards (Arm A phase 2 / Arm B synthesis).

declarations.description: Structured screening declarations the blind grader's machine gates consume; the human auditor may override with a recorded reason.
